messages.subject: Nvim-R working on Windows again
parts:
Hi,

I fixed the TCP connection bug, and the default "master" branch of Nvim-R on github is working on Windows again. I will release a new version in a couple of days, and it would  be great if those using Windows could try the github version of Nvim-R to report any bug that eventually remains.

Thank you!

Jakson Aquino
